how: We read the website of every Seattle wedding photographer listed on Lazo (115 listings, 98 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: lifestyle and family portrait studios, boudoir and senior portrait shops, a Nashville photographer whose domain now serves a poker site, and bundle companies that sell photos alongside DJs and booths. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you shoot in flat grey light and rain? Ask for a full gallery from an overcast or wet Seattle wedding, not a sunny highlight reel.
Is a second photographer included, and who is it? Ask whether the same people show up every time or an associate is sent.
What is the delivery timeline, how many edited images, and is film or a specific editing style the default or an add-on?

picks.name: B. Jones Photography
picks.blurb: Becca Jones founded B. Jones Photography in 2012 and has photographed more than 300 weddings across Seattle, Woodinville, Snohomish and Bellingham in a light and airy, film-inspired style. The site carries a 2026 Seattle wedding photography pricing guide, which is rare.

picks.name: Tony Asgari Photography
picks.blurb: Tony Asgari has photographed Seattle weddings and engagements since 2009 with a style he traces to years of travel with a camera. He publishes his prices and packages on a page updated for 2026, and works the Pacific Northwest and beyond.

picks.name: Alexandra Knight Photography
picks.blurb: Photography found Alexandra Knight in a college darkroom nearly two decades ago, and film is still a big part of her workflow. Based in Edmonds, she shot her first wedding solo in 2010 and pitches herself to couples who want colorful, intentional photos full of personality.

picks.name: NWLifeShots
picks.blurb: Robin of NW Life Shots is a Bellevue wedding photographer and IT whiz who counts seven-plus years and 300 or more weddings, and promises skin tones that do not look like they spent a weekend in the tropics. Photo plus video coverage, now taking inquiries for 2027.

picks.name: Chelsea Abril Photography
picks.blurb: Chelsea Abril is a Seattle and Kona-born photographer with 13 years of candid, joyful weddings and elopements in Hawaii and the Pacific Northwest. Booking starts with a free consult, then a custom package built around the day.

picks.name: Anchor & Lace Photography
picks.blurb: Keith and Alexis are the husband-and-wife studio behind Anchor & Lace in Tacoma, photographing weddings, elopements, engagements and proposals. Their pricing page leads with a promise of no bait and switch: the two of them are the ones who show up.

picks.name: Lindsey Paradiso Photography
picks.blurb: Lindsey Paradiso describes over a decade behind the camera and a documentary approach that treats a wedding as witnessing the heart of a story. Seattle-based, with films available alongside photography and thoughtful planning built into the experience.

picks.name: Blue Rose Photography
picks.blurb: Brittany and Joe of Blue Rose Photography are a husband-and-wife team specializing in fine art film photography for luxury weddings in Seattle and beyond. They met in Los Angeles in 2005, when she was in fashion school and he sang in a band.

picks.name: Jenn Tai & Co
picks.blurb: Jenn Tai & Co is a Seattle collective pairing photojournalism with artistry on both film and digital, with video services as well. Documenting weddings since 2007, with a stated focus on moments big and small and on family.

picks.name: Weddings by Andre
picks.blurb: A Seattle native born and raised, Andre documents weddings, engagements, proposals and courthouse ceremonies across Washington with a mix of candid moments and clean direction. Weddings by Andre lists its investment page openly rather than by inquiry.

picks.name: Yaqi Wang Photography
picks.blurb: Yaqi Wang is a full-time wedding photographer in Washington who speaks English, Mandarin and Hokkien and holds a degree in visual media. Shooting weddings since 2021, with packages that list a private online gallery, a pre-wedding timeline consultation and 450-plus edited images.

picks.name: Valerie Lisuk Photography
picks.blurb: Valerie Lisuk is a Seattle-area adventure elopement photographer who scouts locations, activities and vendors for her couples because she enjoys that part as much as the pictures. Elopement packages come in several sizes, built on the idea that no single package fits everyone.
